mechanics.original_reminder: If you cast this spell from your hand, exile it as it resolves. When you next cast a spell that shares a color with this card, you may cast this from exile without paying its mana cost.
mechanics.executable_reminder: If this spell was cast from your hand, instead of putting it into your graveyard as it resolves, exile it and when you next cast a spell that shares a color with the card exiled this way, you may cast the card exiled this way without paying its mana cost.

rule_text.name: 702.239a
rule_text.rule: Leitmotif appears on some instants and sorceries. It represents a static ability that functions while the spell is on the stack and may create a delayed triggered ability. “Leitmotif” means “If this spell was cast from your hand, instead of putting it into your graveyard as it resolves, exile it and, when you cast a spell that shares a color with this card, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.”

rule_text.name: 702.239b
rule_text.rule: Casting a spell as an effect of its leitmotif ability follows the rules for paying alternative costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

rule_text.name: 702.239c
rule_text.rule: Multiple instances of leitmotif on the same spell are redundant.

rule_text.name: 702.239d
rule_text.rule: Type leitmotif is a variant of the leitmotif ability. “Type leitmotif” means “If this spell was cast from your hand, instead of putting it into your graveyard as it resolves, exile it and, when you cast a spell that shares a type with this card, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.”
